## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] `pnpm e2e` passes, if the client, the views or islands changed
- [ ] A test covers the change, where it can
- [ ] The README of the package says what changed for its users, if anything did
- [ ] Breaking change to a package's `exports`? Say so here
